creator: Alexander Terp
description: From the fix of a_2q9vTXJH7 (2026-11-13). The windowless CLI now sends through the daemon's answered control request (PaneRequest.Send, protocol 1.16) and exits 1 when nothing could be typed. A window's own send still types over the input connection: muster-seam's send_to_pane (crates/muster-seam/src/handler.rs) exits 0 with nothing typed while the agent restarts or its program has stopped reading. Fix: the window uses the answered Send request, so both doors share one path.
title: A window's own pane send drops input the daemon could not queue
